findings.summary: The interval limit was lowered to 365 days in the requirement, entity and IntervalField, but the J.goals journey still tells the user the range is 1-3650 days.
findings.evidence: J.goals g3: "Set interval (1-3650 days), desired depth (light, meaningful or shared-time), preferred channel and enabled" vs spec: "an enabled goal must have intervalDays from 1 through 365"

findings.summary: The IntervalField now has weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly presets, but intervalDays is an integer day count; monthly, quarterly and yearly don't map to a fixed number of days, and no requirement, journey or criterion defines how these presets convert.
findings.evidence: "intervalDays from 1 through 365, with weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly presets"; intervalDays type "int 1..365"

findings.summary: Lowering the upper bound from 3650 to 365 makes any existing goal with an interval above 365 invalid, and nothing in the spec says how such goals are migrated or handled.
findings.evidence: - { name: intervalDays, type: "int 1..3650" } -> + { name: intervalDays, type: "int 1..365" }
